# Test fixtures

`tone.wav`, `tone.m4a` and `tone.flac` are the same 1 second, 440 Hz, 44.1 kHz stereo sine tone
(amplitude 0.8), generated by a script rather than recorded, so there is nothing to license. The M4A
(AAC) and FLAC files were encoded from the WAV with macOS `afconvert`.

No speech is committed. Tests that need real speech and a real model are marked `#[ignore]`; see
`crates/core/tests/whisper_e2e.rs` and `make test-e2e`.
